missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Организм' is masculine and stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Человеческий' is the agreeing masculine adjective, 'сложный' the predicate.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Организм' is inanimate masculine, so its accusative matches the nominative as the object of 'укрепляет'. 'Наш' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Организма' is genitive after 'от', expressing dependence. 'Человека' is a further genitive showing whose organism.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Организму' is dative after 'помогают', which governs that case to mark the one helped.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Организме' is prepositional after 'в', marking location. 'Здоровом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Accusative after preposition. 'Организм' is accusative after 'на' with 'влияет', the fixed pattern for influence. It matches the nominative for this inanimate noun.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Организму' is dative after 'вредят', which governs that case. 'Живому' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Организмы' is the nominative plural subject of 'живут'. 'Разные' is the agreeing plural adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Организмы' is the accusative plural object of 'изучают'; inanimate, so it matches the nominative plural. 'Простые' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural in a question. 'Организмов' is genitive plural after 'сколько', counting the quantity that lives in the soil.
